images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial website hero photography, landscape 3:2, approximately 1536x1024.
Primary request: Create an exceptionally tasteful, calm, contemporary photographic still life for a young Chinese journalism and communication graduate's personal website, with the visual quality of a university arts journal or a refined cultural institution.
Scene: A light warm oak writing desk beside a large off-white architectural window. At the back, understated translucent curtains and a softly out-of-focus leafy courtyard in muted green. On the desk, an open unmarked ivory notebook with gently curved pages, a slim black pen, a compact black and silver camera, and one closed muted brick-red clothbound journal. No people.
Composition: View at desk height from a slight angle, quiet asymmetry, the notebook slightly to the right of center, the camera to its rear left, no clutter. Subjects concentrated in the lower middle of the frame; soft architectural light and ample air above. All objects fully visible, coherent perspective and natural proportions. The image will occupy the right half of a desktop webpage, so use a self-contained image composition with a subtle depth of field.
Lighting: soft morning daylight from the left, nuanced shadows, creamy highlights without haze, realistic paper and fabric textures, clear professional editorial photography.
Palette: warm ivory, pale oak, muted brick red, ink brown, only a little subdued green. Overall luminous, quiet, grounded and youthful.
Constraints: This is a website atmosphere image, not a portrait or evidence of a real location. NO people, faces, hands, computers, screens, coffee cups, flowers, corporate skyline, official emblems, logos, readable text, letters, watermark, UI, frames or collaged graphic decoration. Not an illustration, not a 3D render, not a vintage sepia image, not a plastic AI stock photo.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: exceptionally refined panoramic background for a personal editorial website's interior page headings, landscape 3:1, 1536x512 or larger at this aspect ratio.
Primary request: A minimalist close-up photographic still life of ivory book pages and natural window light. The website concerns journalism, writing, photography and campus communications.
Scene: An off-white matte tabletop. Far to the right, part of an open ivory book with gently curved blank pages, a tiny edge of a muted brick-red cloth cover beneath it. A very soft geometric window shadow falls diagonally across the whole table. No other objects.
Composition: At least the left 65 percent is uninterrupted bright warm ivory negative space, extremely subtle tonal variation, intended to carry dark live HTML text. The cropped book occupies only the rightmost 30 percent, seen from above at a slight angle, extending naturally beyond right edge. Wide elegant architectural horizontal composition, restrained and airy. No high-contrast shadow in the left text area.
Lighting: soft daylight, believable fine uncoated paper texture, gentle cream and light warm gray shadows. Luminous and crisp with no dirty vignette or sepia cast.
Palette: warm ivory #f8f6f0, light oatmeal, muted terracotta on the small book-cover edge. Consistent with warm oak desk editorial photography.
Constraints: NO words, letters, logos, watermark, people, hands, faces, phones, cups, UI, cards, borders, icons, illustrations or abstract 3D shapes. The book pages are blank and physically plausible. No artificially folded impossible paper. This is a decorative atmosphere image, never a document or claim of a real location.

processing: WebP encoding only, original dimensions retained; no retouching.
